name: [NEW] Robots VS Humans
desc:
The game... It's back!!!

--- Gameplay ---
- Build a base, equip up to 4 weapons and fight off robots until the timer ends.
- Or... Become a robot and destroy the humans and their bases!
- All progress permanently saves and carries over, so no need to worry about losing anything!

--- Content ---
- 55 Blocks
- 17 Weapons
- 16 Armors
- 14 Robots
